## Decisions

- **Install @supabase/ssr + @supabase/supabase-js (missing from template)**: The reference doc imports createBrowserClient/createServerClient from @supabase/ssr; the template had neither dependency (alternatives: Hand-rolling fetch wrappers (reinvents the SDK))
- **PUBLIC_PREFIXES covers both doc-listed and accept-listed public paths**: accept names /api/mcp, /sw.js, /manifest.webmanifest; the reference doc expands to /auth, /api/calendar/feed, /api/push/dispatch, /.well-known, /icons/ — union satisfies both (alternatives: Only the 3 accept-listed prefixes (breaks auth pages and calendar/push feeds))
- **getClaims() for session read**: Reference doc + @supabase/ssr guidance: getClaims is the recommended way to read refreshed session data without user round-trips (alternatives: getSession() then getUser() (extra network + user fetch))
